name: Taking Care Of Animals
overview: Scripture reveals that God entrusted mankind with dominion over animals, commanding them to steward and care for all living creatures on earth as part of His design (Genesis 1:26, 1:28). This responsibility includes nurturing and maintaining the environment, as seen when God placed Adam in the Garden of Eden to tend and keep it (Genesis 2:15). Furthermore, the law given to Israel reflects concern for animals, prohibiting work on the Sabbath even for cattle (Exodus 20:10) and instructing the return of a neighbor's lost ox or donkey (Exodus 23:4), demonstrating a God-centered ethic of kindness and stewardship toward animals.
